svg.title: Doctoral research: OCT to material parameter estimation
svg.desc: Volumetric OCT imaging is segmented and meshed. Full-field displacements from image registration and digital volume correlation feed a neural network that predicts virtual-field coefficients. The virtual fields enter the principle of virtual work together with measured deformation and applied loading, enabling constitutive parameter identification.

g.text: uⱼ*(x, y) = Σ aₖ φₖ(x, y)
